notes: PWS-0407 remains done. The unchanged quality metrics were rebound to the evaluated implementation revision, and a synthetic release-test fixture was corrected without weakening the production gate. Genuine first-time-user and keyboard-only human acceptance remains unrecorded, so PWS-0409 stays planned. Human acceptance permits that gate to start; it does not approve a release. Durable package history still requires a versioned schema/migration decision, mixed image/scan transformation with overlays in one output remains unsupported, and no optional technical manifest or sibling interface is introduced. Packaged-build evidence remains TBD.
